messages:
ravi: We had two low-rate OOMs yesterday tied to KV compaction. Opening a short-lived thread to convert PM action items into owners/timeline. Keeping this compact. :mag: 

mei: Thanks. Quick summary from the postmortem: 1) short-term guardrail (limit compaction concurrency + abort on low-host-memory), 2) instrumentation + heapshots, 3) telemetry + backfill, 4) RCA writeup + demo.

harper: I can land the guardrail behind a flag. Proposal: `kv.compact.max_concurrent=2` and abort compaction when host_free_pct < 10. Dark-launch metrics only first. ETA: 20h for flag + rollout playbook.

zain: I will own instrumentation and repro harness. Plan: add compact:start/finish traces, per-shard live_pages gauge, export jemalloc stats periodically. Also will run a normalized repro (compactions/hour) to compare to prod. ETA: 3d for data + initial graphs.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-3721 "kv: compaction-correlated OOMs 1" assigned to mei,zain,harper. Priority: P1. Link: https://tickets/internal/INF-3721

ravi: Owners & short deadlines:
- Harper: feature-flag guardrail + rollout doc / due 20h
- Zain: instrumentation + repro runs / due 72h
- Mei: RCA plan + telemetry backfill (60d) / due 5d
- Ravi: coordinate canary/capacity ops / due 24h

zain: Example commands for reproducible runs:
```
# mini repro harness
./harness/run --qps 50 --dur 45m --compact-interval=30s --heap-snap=60s
# collect jeprof samples after run
scripts/collect_jeprof.sh --out /tmp/jeprof.compact
```

mei: Telemetry plan: add metrics to backfill and dashboard - `kv.compact.count`, `kv.compact.concurrent`, `kv.compact.abort_count`, `kv.fragmentation.ratio`, `kv.live_pages.shard_p95`, host.free_pages.p10. Backfill last 60 days.

harper: Rollout plan: 1) dark metrics (flag on, no behavior change) 0-12h, 2) canary on 2 hosts with abort enabled 24h, 3) expand to 25% if stable. Rollback: flip flag off, drain in-flight compactions.

ravi: Short-term alert: fire when compaction.abort_count > 4 in 10m OR host.free_pages.p5 < 7% during compaction windows.

zain: Status: instrumentation branch opened, basic unit tests green. Blocker: need permission for a 4h staging long-run.

harper: Status: feature-flag PR open, unit tests passed. Will enable dark metrics in ~6h.

mei: Status: starting metric backfill tonight. RCA checklist includes heap histogram diffs pre/during/post compaction, jemalloc active vs allocated, pinned-span checks, and regression-window review for allocator/compaction heuristic changes.

ravi: Follow-up: schedule a short findings demo after initial RCA (owners: mei + zain). Target date: 2025-01-23.

harper: Minor note: if fragmentation looks systemic we may try jemalloc config tweaks as an intermediate mitigation (lg_chunk, decay_time). Keep as contingency.

ravi: We'll use this thread for daily 1-line updates until INF-3721 is closed. Keep updates short (done / blocker). Ping me for urgent escalations. :thumbsup:
